turns.text: Hi, I would like to book a tattoo.

Hello, I can pass your tattoo booking request to a colleague who handles bookings. Could you tell me the idea you have in mind, the size, where on the body you would like it, and when you are available? A colleague will then take over from there.
The idea is a small paper boat, about 8 cm wide, on the outside of my left forearm. I can come on weekday evenings.

Thank you, I have noted the idea, a small paper boat about 8 cm wide, on the outside of your left forearm, with weekday evenings available. I am now passing your booking request to a colleague, who will take it from here. They will be in touch about pricing and dates.
That is the whole description I have.
Thank you, that is all I need. I am handing your booking request to a colleague now, and they will take it from here.
